# agent.json

The edge agent's configuration (`relikey-agent run -config /etc/relikey/agent.json`). Unknown keys are refused, so a misspelt setting never falls back to a default.

| key | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `edge` | string | Required. The edge's id as KeyClerk enrolled it; bundles for another edge are refused. |
| `mode` | string | enforce (default) applies the plan to the bastion; shadow only computes and reports it (the canary). |
| `state_dir` | string | Required. Where the verified bundle, floors and status files live; must be the agent's own, persistent directory. |
| `lab` | boolean | Allows a volatile or shared state directory and a non-loopback bastion: tests and the soak only, never a site. |
| `enrolment_key_file` | string | Required. The edge's enrolment key (relikey-agent keygen), mode 0600, owned by the agent's user. |
| `pins` | object | The keys the edge trusts, pinned on site at enrolment; never fetched from the network. |
| `pins.bundle_key` | string | Required. KeyClerk's bundle signing key (hex), from the enrolment. |
| `pins.officer_key` | string | Required. The edge officer's key (hex), from the officer's own console; it seals the edge's ceiling. |
| `pins.release_key` | string | Optional. KeyClerk's release key (hex); with it, policy modules must be the ones its signed manifest names. |
| `clerk` | object | The clerk role (decision 0023): how the agent reaches the clerk's edge routes, which speak the edge protocol (outbound only; the core never connects in). KeyClerk is the reference clerk. |
| `clerk.url` | string | Required. The desk's edge-facing base URL, https. |
| `clerk.ca_file` | string | Optional. A PEM file with the CA that signs the desk's certificate, when it is not a public one. |
| `clerk.pin_sha256` | string | Optional. The sha256 of the desk certificate's public key; with it, any other certificate is refused. |
| `clerk.proxy` | string | Optional. An http(s) proxy for the outbound connection to the desk. |
| `bastion` | object | The bastion role (decision 0023): which bastion the agent drives and how it reaches its admin API on the edge's loopback (decision 0008). |
| `bastion.kind` | string | Required. The bastion's adapter: warpgate (the reference bastion). Any other value is refused. |
| `bastion.url` | string | Required. https on 127.0.0.1 or [::1], with the admin API path (Warpgate: /@warpgate/admin/api). |
| `bastion.token_file` | string | Required. A file holding the bastion's admin token, mode 0600. |
| `bastion.pin_sha256` | string | Required. The sha256 of the bastion's certificate public key (relikey-agent pin). |
| `bastion.sso_provider` | string | Required. The name of the bastion's single sign-on provider for the core broker (decision 0010). |
| `bastion.governed_roles_file` | string | Optional. A SCIM list of the roles only leases grant (deploy/edge/targets.py writes it from the edge's targets file): an account the agent does not manage holding one is reported in the drift, never changed. Read every tick; absent, unmanaged accounts are not checked (full-stack run 2, finding 8). |
| `fleet` | object | Optional: ReliKey's fleet service (decision 0026). The agent sends its signed report to url/fleet/v1/report every pull interval; url must be the clerk's own scheme and host (the front's edge-facing name), so the same pinned, hybrid-only client carries it. Absent: no reports. |
| `fleet.url` | string | Optional. https on the clerk's own host: the fleet service's report route, behind the front (decision 0026). |
| `tick_seconds` | integer | How often the agent reconciles the bastion with the live leases, in seconds (default 15). |
| `pull_seconds` | integer | How often the agent pulls a bundle from the desk, in seconds (default 60). |
| `long_poll_seconds` | integer | How long the desk may hold a pull until the edge's bundle changes, in seconds (KeyClerk decision 0026): 0 is the default 55, at most 55, -1 pulls plainly. A desk without long-poll answers at once, and the agent falls back to pull_seconds. |
| `grace_seconds` | integer | How long removals may still run after a shutdown signal, in seconds (default 5); keep it below the stop timeout. |
